CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.error: Says a faster tune is a higher tune.

example.question: A song is sung again more quickly. What changed?

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.reveals: Offer "the pitch went higher" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.help: Sing a low tune quickly and a high tune slowly.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.feedback: Faster is tempo. It does not make the notes higher.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.error: Thinks a tune with new words is a new song.

example.question: The tune stays the same but the words change. Is it a new tune?
example.correct_answer: no, the same tune with new words

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.cause: The child remembers songs by their words.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.reveals: Offer "yes, a new tune" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.help: Hum the tune without words, then sing both versions.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.feedback: The tune is the same. Only the words changed.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.error: Says nothing changed when only the speed changed.

example.question: The song was sung slowly, then fast. Did anything change?
example.wrong_answer: no, it is the same song

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.cause: The child listens only for the words and tune.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.reveals: Offer "no, it is the same song" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.help: March to the song slowly and then fast.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.feedback: The speed changed, so the tempo changed.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.MELODY_VARIATION.M.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

example.question: The teacher says "loud". How do you sing?
example.wrong_answer: shout as hard as you can
example.correct_answer: sing strongly but still in tune

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.cause: Loud is the same as shouting in the playground.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.reveals: Offer "shout as hard as you can" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.help: Sing loud, then shout, and listen for which keeps the tune.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.feedback: Loud singing is strong and still in tune. Shouting is not singing.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.error: Slows down when told to sing softly.

example.question: The teacher says "soft". What changes?
example.correct_answer: we sing more quietly at the same speed

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.cause: Soft and slow often go together in lullabies.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.reveals: Offer "we sing slower" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.help: Clap a steady beat and sing softly over it without slowing.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.feedback: Soft means quiet. The speed stays the same.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.error: Gets louder when told to sing fast.

example.question: The teacher says "fast". What changes?

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.cause: Excitement makes the child sing faster and louder together.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.reveals: Offer "we sing louder" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.help: Sing fast and soft, like a whisper race.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.feedback: Fast means quick. It does not have to be loud.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.error: Reads hands held close together as loud.

example.question: The teacher holds her hands close together. What does it mean?

CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.feedback: Hands close together mean soft. Hands wide apart mean loud.
CREA.G3.CREATI.MELODY.PERF_DIRECTIONS.M_.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.error: Starts every row the same way (over first), so the strips slide out.

example.question: Row 1 started over. How should row 2 start?

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.cause: The child copies the row above exactly.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.reveals: Offer "over, the same as row 1" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.help: Weave two rows the same way and lift the paper: the strip falls out.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.feedback: Start each new row the opposite way to the one before.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.error: Goes over two strips and under one in a plain weave.

example.question: In a plain weave, how does the strip go?

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.cause: The child skips strips by accident when the slits are close.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.reveals: Offer "over two, under one" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.help: Say "over, under, over, under" aloud with each strip.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.feedback: A plain weave goes over one and under one.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.error: Cuts the slits right through to the edge of the base paper.

example.question: When you cut slits in the base paper, how far do you cut?
example.correct_answer: stop before the edge so the paper holds together

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.cause: The child cuts until the scissors stop.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.reveals: Offer "right to the edge" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.help: Show a base cut to the edge falling into strips.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.feedback: Stop cutting before the edge so the base holds the warp.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.error: Thinks the colours of the strips do not matter to the pattern.

example.question: Why use two colours in a paper weave?
example.correct_answer: so the over and under pattern shows

CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.cause: The child has not seen a weave in one colour.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.reveals: Offer "it does not matter" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.help: Compare a weave in one colour with one in two colours.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.feedback: Two colours make the chequered pattern show.
CREA.G3.CREATI.WEAVING.PAPER_WEAVE.M_CAC.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.error: Thinks the groups in a round sing different songs.

example.question: In a round, what do the groups sing?
example.correct_answer: the same song, starting at different times

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.cause: The sound is mixed, so the child thinks the songs differ.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.reveals: Offer "different songs" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.help: Sing the round slowly with two groups, then each group alone.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.feedback: In a round every group sings the same song, starting at different times.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_DI.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_TO.error: Thinks a round starts with all groups together.

example.question: Do all groups start a round together?
example.correct_answer: no, one group starts, then the next joins later

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_TO.reveals: Offer "yes" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_TO.help: Point to group 1 to start; point to group 2 after one line.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_TO.feedback: In a round each group starts later than the one before.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_TO.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.error: Switches to the other group's words when they hear them.

example.question: In a round you hear the other group singing a different line. What do you do?

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.cause: The child follows the loudest voices.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.reveals: Offer "join their line" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.help: Practise with a hand over one ear, keeping your own words.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.feedback: Keep to your own part even when you hear other words.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_JO.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.error: Calls a song sung all together a round.

example.question: The whole class sings the same words at the same time. Is that a round?
example.correct_answer: no, it is singing in unison

CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.cause: Any group song seems a round to the child.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.reveals: Offer "yes" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.help: Sing a song in unison, then as a round, and compare.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.feedback: Singing together at the same time is unison. A round starts at different times.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.ROUNDS.ROUND.M_CAC3_RO_UN.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.error: Thinks galloping is hopping on one leg.

example.question: Is galloping the same as hopping?
example.correct_answer: no; in galloping both feet touch the ground, one leading

CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.reveals: Offer "yes" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.

example.question: In a gallop, which foot leads?
example.correct_answer: the same foot leads every time

example.question: Step-hop, step-hop, changing feet. Is that a gallop?

CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.reveals: Offer "yes" next to the right answer and ask the question again in a new context.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.help: Do a gallop and a skip to the same drum and compare.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.feedback: Step-hop changing feet is a skip. A gallop keeps one foot leading.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.GALLOPING.GALLOP.M_CAC3_G.error: Thinks you cannot gallop to the side.

CREA.G3.PERFOR.SCULPTURE_TOY_ASSEMBLAGE..feedback: Ask an adult to cover sharp edges before you use them.
CREA.G3.PERFOR.SCULPTURE_TOY_ASSEMBLAGE..source: To confirm by a CBC Creative Activities teacher: a common classroom error, not traced to a study by the author.
